summary: The @gyomu/infra package provides a robust collection of infrastructure services and utility layers designed for Effect-based applications. It abstracts low-level system interactions such as file system management, database connectivity, network communication, and data serialization. This package serves as a foundational building block for complex business logic by enforcing consistent error handling and dependency injection patterns.
responsibilities: Provide uniform wrappers and error handling for platform-specific I/O operations.
Manage centralized application configuration via environment-driven providers.
Define service layers that facilitate dependency injection for databases and external APIs.
Enable streaming-based data transformation between structured models and external formats.
Encapsulate infrastructure concerns to decouple business logic from runtime environments.

capabilities.name: File System Orchestration
capabilities.description: Comprehensive suite of operations for file and directory management, including metadata retrieval, searching, and stream-based I/O.

capabilities.name: Database Abstraction
capabilities.description: Integrated services for SQL database interactions, featuring connection management, repository patterns, and custom query execution.

capabilities.name: Network and Web Integration
capabilities.description: Tools for performing HTTP requests, web scraping, document parsing, and processing remote data streams.

capabilities.name: Data Serialization and Parsing
capabilities.description: Bidirectional conversion capabilities between structured data models and common formats like CSV, XML, YAML, and JSON.

capabilities.name: Security and Authentication
capabilities.description: Utility layer for JWT-based identity management and cryptographic operations like SHA-256 hashing.

capabilities.name: Archive Handling
capabilities.description: Support for inspecting, reading, and extracting contents from ZIP and TAR archives within stream pipelines.

designDecisions: Heavy reliance on the Effect ecosystem to handle side effects, resource management, and error propagation.
Implementation of a service-layer architecture that treats external interactions as injectable dependencies.
Preference for stream-based processing to maintain high performance and memory efficiency when handling large datasets.
Strict type-safety through schema-based validation for all data input and output operations.
usageGuidance: Utilize the defined Layer objects to compose application environments and manage dependency initialization at startup.
Always wrap file and network operations in the provided error-handling utilities to ensure consistent failure types.
Prefer the provided repository generators when interacting with databases to benefit from built-in consistency checks.
Leverage the streaming API for CSV and file operations to avoid memory exhaustion with large inputs.
